body:
Redline round 4

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (96f014f..cb7fdc1) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 3 fixes did what they said and introduced no correctness bugs. R3-6 replaces `plannedTask(id)` with `plannedFiles(id).length === 0` inside the `if (decision)` branch of `isDeferral` (workflows/redline-loop.js:3832). There `roundDecisions[d.id]` is set, so `plannedFiles` reads the resolve's tasks, and because `RESOLVE_SCHEMA` (line 882) requires each task's `files`, "no task with files" and "an empty union of those files" mean the same thing. No reference to `plannedTask` is left. The other fixes are a comment rewrap (R3-5), the SKILL.md and standards prose for R3-1 to R3-3 (now consistent with what `draftView` and `deferredEntry` compute for `ships` at each stop), and new loop-test checks that pin them.

No findings.
